title: SDSS redshift-slice structure audit
question: Which redshift concentrations are visible in a preserved 12,000-galaxy SDSS emission-line sample?
results: strongest 0.005-wide concentration at z≈0.077 with local excess 4.7 sigma
validation: Redshift concentration is compared with a smoothed baseline and jackknifed across four RA intervals.
provenance: SDSS DR18 SQL result preserved by BPT notebook
12,000 spectra with coordinates, redshifts, and line measurements
limitations: z is used as a radial proxy rather than a cosmological distance
local excess ignores correlated large-scale-structure covariance
